iWantTo: see a stock record display batch and serial as distinct, separately addressable fields on the stock view wherever the combined tracking code used to be shown, including a clear 'none yet' when a field is NULL
soThat: I can read and reference batch and serial on their own instead of decoding one opaque combined code

independence.rationale: S1 and S2 deliver only the schema migration and its reversal (no rendered UI); this story adds the SPA-facing behavior that surfaces batch_number and serial_number as separate labelled fields (and their empty state) in the stock view, which no migration story builds and can be failed independently by breaking only the client rendering.
